purpose: Manually dispatched bulk labelling of every open PR (or one PR) from branch prefix, changed files and PR content via scripts/batch-label-prs.js; dry-run by default.
triggers: workflow_dispatch (inputs: dry_run choice default "true", pr_number string)

jobs.summary: Checkout (fetch-depth 0), setup Node from .nvmrc, `npm ci || true`, run scripts/batch-label-prs.js with --dry-run and/or --pr=<n>, upload labeling-report.json (30 days).

failure_points.issue: `npm ci || true` hides dependency installation failures; the script then fails later with a less obvious error.
`inputs.pr_number` is interpolated directly into the shell command (script injection vector for anyone able to dispatch).
Script branch-prefix map emits labels that are not in labels.yml (type:documentation, type:dependencies instead of type:docs, type:dependency).
Script hard-codes OWNER/REPO to lightspeedwp/.github, so the workflow is not portable to other repositories.
A fourth independent branch-to-type map (also in labeling.agent.js, .github/labeler.yml and scripts/pr-template-router.js), so the maps drift.
Actions pinned to mutable tags, whereas the active labeling-unified.yml pins commit SHAs.
